light.notes: Nord publishes no light variant; this one is built from its Snow Storm and Polar Night groups. bg nord5, paper nord6, chip nord4; border-hover derived (nord4 toward nord3); text-3 is nord3 brightened; aurora colours as published, pale on light. on-amber and on-purple are pinned to white: the ink rule would take nord0 on them, a light-mode change MAD-376 left for later

dark.notes: bg nord0, paper nord1, chip nord2, border-hover nord3; primary nord8 is Nord's primary accent; blue nord9. red is nord11 lifted from 56% to 67% lightness so red text meets 3:1 on nord2 (MAD-372). amber (nord12) and purple (nord15) are lifted from 63% to 65% so nord0 ink reads 4.5 on them, where white sat at 2.8 (MAD-376). The roles derived from the three stay pinned to the published values, and the ink rule picks nord0 for on-red, on-amber, and on-purple
